name: B10-0424/2026 – After § 14 – Am 103
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 14a. Highlights that assessments of organisations receiving or applying for public funding should rely on concrete and measurable criteria, including respect for democratic principles, fundamental rights and freedoms, equality before the law, rejection of violence and compliance with applicable legal frameworks, rather than on broad categories or assumptions based on ideological, religious or cultural background;
